input_roles: User's two tall green/yellow advertisements are style references. Existing square app icon is identity reference. New artwork, not edits of prior posters.

assets.1005:
Use case: ads-marketing. Produce a COMPLETE polished portrait A3 print advertisement, aspect 297:420, matching the two tall advertisement reference images supplied by the user: very rich emerald/forest-green photographic background with dimensional light gradients and subtle blurred leaves at the corners, warm wood counter at bottom, bold dimensional white and sunflower-yellow Uzbek typography, energetic but clean yellow/orange accent strokes, photographic hero objects occupying lower half. Not a white minimalist flyer. Premium professional local marketplace campaign, crisp realistic texture and clean readable print typography.
Input images roles: two tall green Kashtan market posters are STYLE/COMPOSITION REFERENCES only; the square green-basket/orange-handle icon is our real identity reference. Use the correct name "Besh Kashtan", not Kashtan market, no new identity.
CRITICAL COMPOSITING SLOTS: At top left leave one pure-white, completely EMPTY rounded-square app-logo tile (no drawing inside) roughly 12% of poster width; next to it put the exact brand "Besh Kashtan" in white. The actual existing logo will be added to the tile later. On the RIGHT MIDDLE put a large frontal perfectly square PURE WHITE EMPTY QR panel with a thick yellow/orange rim and green outside border. Inside must be COMPLETELY WHITE with NO QR modules, no icon, no text, no gradient. Center the panel about 78% of image width and 47% of image height, approximately 31% of image width square. It must remain entirely above the hero table and not intersect any object. A real machine-readable QR will be inserted later. Under this panel one orange rounded CTA "Ilovani yuklab oling". A curved white/yellow arrow may point to the panel without entering it.
Include a small row of simple white line icons under the headline but LEFT of the QR panel; ONLY these two short labels: "Ilovadan buyurtma" and "Manzilga yetkazish". At bottom include two crisp black rounded download-label pills with exact labels "Google Play" and "App Store"; no prices, no 'free', no discount, no speed promise, no '20 years', no certifications, no unprovided address or telephone. Keep all text 5% away from edges, no watermarks, no repeated nonsense copy.
Keep intentional hierarchy and attractive photographic dimensional depth like the references. No fake tiny detailed app UI; if a phone appears show a simple neutral blurred product catalogue without legible invented controls or promotions.
Specific poster: household/hardware retailer "1005 xil mahsulot". Exact main headline in the top third: "1005 xil mahsulot" (large white), "endi ilovada!" (yellow). Beneath it a clearly readable yellow/green ribbon: "Yetkazib berish xizmati ishga tushdi!" in dark or white contrasting text. An angled smartphone on the lower LEFT, a delivery cardboard box in lower middle overflowing with recognizable generic household/hardware goods: electric drill, hand tools, compact kettle, electrical socket, light bulb, neatly coiled hose, small cleaning bottle and yellow toy truck. Natural product proportions and believable assembly, no branded product labels, no food. Warm wood and soft greenery behind. Green and orange realistic physical palette. Box is plain, no AI invented logo. Do not draw QR or the app icon in the reserved blank slots.
